ἧσαι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 2 sg. mid.: ’you sit’
ἰδνώθη: ἰδνόω — bend, double up; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was bent double’
ἰθακήσιος: Ἰθακήσιος — of Ithaca, Ithacan; masc. nom. sg.
ἱπποδάμων: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. gen. pl.
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’
ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past general relative clause: ’whom he might see’
ἴψεται: ἴπτομαι — press hard, smite, afflict; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’he will smite’
ἵδρυε: ἱδρύω — make sit, seat, settle; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’seat!’
ἵνά: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. (accent from the following enclitic)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀνείδεά: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη)
ὀνειδίζων: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, revile, taunt; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’reviling’
ὀξέα: ὀξύς — sharp, keen, shrill; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’shrilly’
ὀπήδει: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, contracted -ει: ’kept company with’
ὁμοκλήσασκέ: ὁμοκλάω — call out sternly, rebuke; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’would rebuke’
ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’
ὤμω: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual nom./acc.: ’two shoulders’
ῥέξῃ: ῥέζω — do, perform, accomplish; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest he do’

__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’)
__broaden__.δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear, tears; neut. acc. sg., object of χέω: ’shedding tears’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a tear’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀπομόρξατο ’wiped away’
__broaden__.κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc./nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom./voc. pl. in abuse, with ἐλέγχεα: ’base disgraces’
__broaden__.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’)
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’)
__broaden__.μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
__broaden__.μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἕρματα · also agreeing with κύματα: ’tall (waves)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βοάω: ’loudly’ (μακρὰ βοῶν)
__broaden__.ξυνέηκε: συνίημι — bring together, set together; aor. 3 sg., old spelling ξυν- (= συν-), epic -έηκε (= συνῆκε) · also συνίημι — perceive, understand; aor. 3 sg. (ξυνέηκε θεᾶς ὄπα ’understood the voice of the goddess’)
__broaden__.οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’)
__broaden__.τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’)
__broaden__.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’)
__broaden__.τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις)
__broaden__.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’)
__broaden__.ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
__broaden__.ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’)
__broaden__.ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί)
__broaden__.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’)
__broaden__.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’)
__broaden__.ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
__broaden__.ὀνείδεα: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’reproaches’ (λέγ’ ὀνείδεα ’spoke reproaches’)
__broaden__.ἥρωες: ἥρως — hero; masc. voc. pl. (same as nom.), in address: ’heroes!’ · also nom. pl., subject: ’the heroes’ (ἥρωες Δαναοί … διδοῦσιν)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’)
__broaden__.μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’)
